about: Eight regular bromhexine supplies span September to March, and L054 links that course to COPD and records zero flare-ups in the year covering those supplies.
Possible finding: two brand-only supplies and a dated note show routine maintenance use, but the record holds no line about COPD or its stability.

COPD is recorded, but it is flaring up (an acute exacerbation line, prednisolone and an antibiotic on 9 February 2026), so it is not stable. Bromhexine is supplied only twice, in the weeks after the flare-up.
